commit.message:
Board: claims, heartbeats, releases with proof, addressed notes, generated AGENT_CHAT.md

Replaces hand-edited AGENT_CHAT.md with an append-only SQLite board
(~/.bf/bf.sqlite): component-wise path overlap, idempotent re-claim,
30-minute leases extended by heartbeat, STALE on expired claims, release
with `--proof '<cmd>'` that runs the command and records exit code,
output digest, changed paths and HEAD, notes addressed to an agent/claim/PR
with an inbox (`bf board --to me`) and a trailer on every write, writer
identity from the observed process tree, and an atomically regenerated
digest with straggler import after the end marker.

Plan of record PR 5: ~/.claude/plans/please-study-the-tips-snazzy-canyon.md
